notes: The Orb Compass arrives, with a new Orb. The provided Opal build replaces the old Lens entirely: an opal sphere in a baked silicone socket that samples your wallpaper, tilts toward your finger on springs, and sits still at rest. It is the Orb now — no user-facing Lens remains. Four pulls from the Orb: DOWN opens the Stream — what needs you, as sentences with provenance (Stage 1: notifications from people + your next calendar event; promo notifications are dismissed from the system shade as they arrive and counted honestly as handled silently). RIGHT opens Reach (a hold still works too). LEFT opens device controls — brightness, volume, ring mode, flashlight. UP opens Ask. Dragging previews each panel under your finger; release past halfway to commit, release early and it springs back.
